description:
The gate subsystem holds a validation-rule constructor in its presets, a checker entry point and a one-line passthrough, none of which production reaches.

## Background

- `preview_coverage_rule` (`crates/jit/src/gate_presets/planning.rs:81`) is called only by its own tests (`:159-249`) and a doctest (`:44-57`). It is re-exported at `gate_presets.rs:15,19`, and the 252-line module holds nothing else. `sdd_bracket_tests.rs:109` and `research_bracket_tests.rs:117` share the name but check example rules.
- `gate_execution::execute_gate_checker` (`gate_execution.rs:26-39`) is called only by about ten tests in `gate_execution.rs`. Production calls `execute_gate_checker_with_context` (`commands/gate_check.rs:1342`).
- `reusable_verdict` (`commands/gate_check.rs:1043-1049`) forwards to `self.storage.find_reusable_gate_run` and has one caller (`:928`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `gate_presets/planning.rs` and its re-exports no longer exist, and gate presets hold no validation-rule constructor.
- [hard] REQ-02: `execute_gate_checker` no longer exists, and its tests call the context-taking entry point production uses.
- [hard] REQ-03: `reusable_verdict` no longer exists, and its caller queries storage directly.
title: Remove test-only gate entry points
